hooks.command: bash -c "CMD='$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND'; if echo \"$CMD\" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/|rm\s+-rf\s+\.|git\s+push.*--force.*main|git\s+reset\s+--hard'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive command detected. Use a safer alternative.'; exit 2; fi"

bash -c "FILE='$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH'; if echo \"$FILE\" | grep -qE '(calculator|financial-engine|dcf-engine|monte-carlo-engine|waterfall-engine|stress-test-engine|comps-engine|appreciation-engine|cost-insurance-engine|loan-calculator|closing-cost-engine|confluence|bubble-detection|leading-indicator|market-forecast|municipal-prediction)'; then echo 'FINANCIAL/QUANT ENGINE MODIFIED — run /verify-calculation and /test unit before committing'; fi; if echo \"$FILE\" | grep -qE 'generateMock'; then echo 'MOCK DATA DETECTED — ensure this is dev-only code, never ship to production'; fi; if echo \"$FILE\" | grep -qE '\.(env|key|secret|token)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Possible secret file — do NOT commit credentials'; exit 2; fi"
